This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Transcendent Moment
perks.desc: Final blows grant bonus stats based on the weapon's damage type alignment. Light elements grant stability and handling. Dark elements grant range and aim assist. While Transcendent, this weapon gets both bonuses.

perks.name: Recycled Energy
perks.desc: Reloading after defeating targets grants energy to your lowest charged ability.

perks.name: Heal Clip
perks.desc: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.desc: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Burning Ambition
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage scorches the target. Dealing damage to a scorched target inflicts scorch.

perks.name: Binary Orbit
perks.desc: Elemental final blows opposite this weapon increase damage for a short duration. Darkness final blows boost Arc, Solar, and Void weapons. Light final blows boost Stasis, Strand, and Kinetic weapons.

perks.name: Incandescent
perks.desc:
Defeating a target spreads scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Chaos Reshaped
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage while in combat for an extended time. Remaining in combat for even longer rewards a larger damage bonus and periodically heals the wielder.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Dream Work
perks.desc: Once per reload, assists or assisted final blows partially refill the weapon from reserves and increase reload speed for a short duration. Bows receive faster draw time.

perks.name: Tex Balanced Stock
perks.desc: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 149 from 12 August 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/2bhcY40IAVpSlQ0iaW50v0?si=5e88adac224e4ae9) with @ImpetusAlways and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing minor adds both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly for solar builds. At the time of writing, Yeartime Apex is one of the best solar SMGs that offers the usual Lightweight frame advantages of +20 to the hidden Mobility stat and ×1.0625 base movement speed. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are decent - d2foundry.gg calculates that 29 Range equates to 12.19m hipfire and 17.06m when ADS before damage dropoff, 40 Stability ×1.0625 flinch resistance, 64 Handling is 0.32s ready, 0.24s ADS and 0.29s stow speed, and 27 Reload Speed is a 2.16s reload. Ammo Generation is 69, Recoil Direction is 100 and Zoom is 14. On M+KB, you can choose to boost Handling and maybe a little Range, although on controller you might want to invest the barrel perk into Stability. The combat effect magazine perks are all good, or look to boost reload speed. In the first trait perk column Demolitionist is always helpful to generate +10% (+11% when enhanced) grenade energy, modified by your grenade stat, on enemy kills. Attrition Orbs can also be useful, generating a small power orb after 29 hits at base magazine size. In the second column, for solar builds, Burning Ambition can be useful in endgame content but does need building into, to inflict scorch on a target with an ability (hence why Demolitionist is a good match), and then maximise stacks building to ignition with Ember of Ashes. The Dreamwork Origin Trait is decent in PvE when you're in a fireteam, by boosting reload speed for a few seconds and also refilling, and potentially overflowing, 66% of the mag from reserves when killing enemies while teamshooting. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
